description: Click an element (prefer the ref from a snapshot). Waits until it is actionable, re-resolves refs that went stale, and returns a fresh snapshot afterwards. Dialogs are handled and reported automatically.

ref.description: The [eN] id shown in a snapshot

selector.description: CSS selector (fallback when no ref is available)

snapshot.description: Include a snapshot after clicking (default true)

name: browser_click
